display_long_description:
**Turn your room into a mixed-reality battlefield.**

Quantum Strike is a fast-paced mixed reality passthrough shooter for Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S. Portals tear open inside your real space, enemies pour through, and you fight back with futuristic weapons, shields, upgrades, and help from your AI companion, K2.

Play **solo**, team up in **co-op**, or battle other players in **PvP** — with support for both same-room local play **and** online multiplayer with players anywhere.

[media]
--

# **Features:**

- **Mixed Reality Combat** — Turn your whole room into a sci-fi battlefield.
 
- **Solo, Co-op, and PvP** — Fight alone, team up against enemies, or battle other players. 

- **Local & Online Multiplayer** — Play in the same physical space or connect online with players anywhere. 

- **Weapons, Gear, and Upgrades** — Build your loadout with advanced weapons, land mines, plasma grenades, experimental gear, and unlockable upgrades. 

- **Level Up and Earn Rewards** — Complete missions, earn XP and currency, unlock Guardian helmets, upgrade weapons, and expand your arsenal. 

- **Custom Arenas and Matchmaking** — Create battle spaces with Forge Mode and jump into PvP with friends or players online. 

- **Leaderboards and Replayability** — Survive waves, climb the leaderboard, and chase better runs.

- **AI Companion** — Get tactical guidance, mission support, and answers from K2 along the way.

- **Built for Quest 3 and Quest 3S** — Designed around passthrough, room-scale movement, and fast mixed reality gameplay.


[media]
